description: Send the traveller's request to Vuelo's support team, who will be in touch with them. Use it whenever the traveller wants something done to a Vuelo booking that the other tools cannot do, or wants a person: change dates or names after paying, a refund question, a payment problem, a complaint, anything. It works in any conversation: pass the taskId if the booking was made in this chat; otherwise their Vuelo booking reference (VU-...) and the email or mobile they booked with, or just their email if they have no reference. To cancel a booking made in this chat, use cancel_booking first: it raises the request itself when Vuelo's team has to do it. Write the message in the traveller's words, with what they want and why. Tell them the ticket reference and reply time this returns.

email.description: The email the traveller booked with: needed when there is no taskId, or when this tool asks for it.

message.description: What the traveller wants, in their words.

mobile.description: With reference, instead of email: the mobile on the booking.

reference.description: The Vuelo booking reference (VU-...), when there is no taskId.

taskId.description: The taskId book_trip returned, when the booking was made in this conversation.
